भूयं The state of being or
becoming; as in ब्रह्मभूयं; दाशरथिभूयं
Śi. 14. 81.

भूयशस् ind.
1 Mostly,
generally, commonly, as a general rule.
--2 Exceedingly, in a high degree.
--3 Again, more further.

भूयस् a. (सी f.) [अतिशयेन बहु
ईयसुन्]
1 More, more numerous or
abundant.
--2 Greater, larger;

.
--3 More important.
--4 Very
great or large, much, many,
numerous; भवति च पुनर्भूयान्भेदः फलं प्रति
तद्यथा

.
--5 Rich
or abounding in; एवंप्रायगुणभूयसीं
स्वकृतिं

.
--6 Vehement,
severe. --ind.
1 Much, very much,
exceedingly, largely, greatly.
--2
More, again, further more,
moreover; पाथेयमुत्सृज बिसं ग्रहणाय भूयः

.
--3
Repeatedly, frequently; पूर्वं भूयः
first, in the first place --next,
in the next place. (The form
भूयसा is often used adverbially in the
sense of {1} very much, in a high
[]
degree, exceedingly, beyond
measure, for the greater part; न खरो
न च भूयसा मृदुः

; पश्चार्धेन
प्रविष्टः शरपतनभयात् भूयसा पूर्वकायं
Ś. 1. 7. {2} generally, as a general
rule; भूयसा जीविधर्म एवः

).
--Comp.
--कर a. augmenting,
increasing.
--दर्शनं {1} frequent
observation; भूयोभूयोदर्शनेन यत्र यत्र
धूमस्तत्र तत्राग्निरितिं व्याप्तिं गृहीत्वा T. S.
{2} an inference based on frequent
and wide observation.
--भूयस् ind.
again and again, repeatedly: भूयोभूयः
सविधनगरीरथ्यया पर्यटंतं

भूयिष्ठ a. [अतिशयेन बहु इष्ठन् भ्वादेशे
युक् च]
1 Most, most numerous or
abundant.
--2 Most important,
principal, chief.
--3 Very great or large,
very much, much, many, numerous.
--4 Chiefly or for the most part
composed of, mostly composed or
consisting of, chiefly filled with or
characterized by (at the end of
comp.); अभिरूपभूयिष्ठा परिषद्
Ś. 1; शूल्यमांसभूयिष्ठ आहारोऽश्यते Ś. 2;
राष्ट्रेषु कतमत्सुपुरुषभूयिष्ठं Dk.;
शिल्पदारिकाभूयिष्ठं परिजतं

.
--5 Almost, mostly, nearly all
(usually after a past passive
participle); अये उदितभूयिष्ठ एष तपनः

.
--ष्ठं ind.
1 For
the most part, mostly; Ś. 1. 31.
--2 Exceedingly, very much, in the
highest degree; भूयिष्ठं भव दक्षिणा
परिजने Śi. 4. 17;
